work.title: Software Development Intern
bullets: Shipped an event-driven pipeline (**S3**, **Lambda**, **Bedrock** all in **Kotlin**) grading AI oncall agents against human fixes and proposing corrections to the agent spec files that misled them, improving root-cause accuracy on unseen tickets to **78%** and cutting wrong diagnoses by **~50%**.

projects.name: Hybrid Attribution & Pruning for Transformer Circuits

Designed a novel Hybrid Attribution and Pruning (HAP) framework that combines attribution patching with edge pruning to discover faithful LLM circuits **46% faster** than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.
Implemented custom evaluation pipelines in **PyTorch/TensorFlow**, optimizing GPU memory usage on NVIDIA H100 clusters to benchmark performance against SOTA methods (hosted on **Runpod**).

projects.name: LoSeR: Decomposable High-Frequency Trading Architecture
bullets: Architected a novel hybrid framework (**LoSeR**) that decomposes time-series into linear and spectral trends, using **Statistical Recurrent Units** to model residuals and outperform **LSTMs** in capturing long-range dependencies.

Engineered a multi-horizon forecasting engine (predicting 1, 10, 30, 60-minute intervals) that implements dynamic uncertainty-based thresholding (RMSE scaling) to optimize trade execution, demonstrating profitable generalization on high-volatility S&P 500 data.

projects.name: Algorithmic Tennis Betting Agent
